cases.about: “Everybody loved going to the pool and swimming with Mom, and it’s just different this summer,” (her son Jack Kilgore) said. “Now the kids are like ‘I wish grandma was here to go to the pool!”“Everybody loved going to the pool and swimming with Mom, and it’s just different this summer,” he said. “Now the kids are like ‘I wish grandma was here to go to the pool!” “Everybody loved going to the pool and swimming with Mom, and it’s just different this summer,” he said. “Now the kids are like ‘I wish grandma was here to go to the pool!” “She was a very loved woman,” said Jack’s wife, Shayna. “She has a lot of family that misses her.”
cases.narrative: On 2/26/2023, her body was found in a roadside ditch in the area of 152nd Street and Old Mormon Bridge Road, near Crescent, IA. Her body was found still frozen to the ground, and authorities believe that "she had been in this location possibly since the time she went missing," according to court documents. An initial autopsy could not determine how Gowan died because of the level of decomposition. Court documents say Ilene was found with bruises all over her body, and with a large laceration on her head. An autopsy didn’t indicate a cause of death, though. Several months later, they obtained a second opinion from a different doctor, who determined Gowan died of asphyxiation.
